relationships.subject: miR-143
relationships.evidence_quote: miR-143 expression was significantly downregulated after spinal nerve ligation (SNL) injury, leading to an increase in Dnmt3a mRNA and protein expression in the dorsal root ganglia (DRG)

relationships.subject: miR-142-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: miR-142-3p targeted HMGB1 (high mobility group box 1) to lower its expression to relieve neuralgia symptoms

relationships.subject: miR-206-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: miR-206-3p targets BDNF (brain-derived neurotrophic factor) to relieve nerve pain

key_findings: Review of miRNA, lncRNA and circRNA roles in neuropathic pain, including miR-143/Dnmt3a epigenetic axis in DRG.
HMGB1 is a common target gene of several ncRNAs in neuropathic pain.
